title: OpenAI claims an ex-employee took its product plans and presented them to Apple
slides: OpenAI says an ex-employee walked out with product plans
Those plans reportedly went straight to Apple
The employee went to Apple before resigning?
Your vendor roadmaps may already be visible
Check who owns strategy docs Monday morning
thread_text:
1. The silent exit

An OpenAI employee allegedly walked out with product plans — and handed them to Apple. No lawsuit, no public statement. Just a quiet transfer of strategy.

2. The timing doesn't add up

Reports suggest the employee was already in talks with Apple before resigning. That changes this from a leak to a planned handoff.

3. Your roadmap isn't private

Vendor strategy docs are often accessible to anyone with the right permissions. If one person can copy them, so can others.

4. The real risk isn't theft

It's that you won't know until a competitor ships the feature you were planning for next quarter.

5. Check your access logs

Open your document history today. See who viewed your strategy deck in the last 30 days. If you can't, that's your answer.
